title: Scheme base change of a moduli groupoid and of a scheme map
statement: Let $S,S^{\prime}$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], let $g:S^{\prime}\to S$, and let $p:\mathcal F\to\mathit{Sch}/S$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, using the total-category and 2-fibre-product convention of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Define $\mathcal F_{S^{\prime}}$ over $\mathit{Sch}/S^{\prime}$ as the iso-comma category of $p$ and composition with $g$: its objects are triples $(x,T,\alpha)$, where $x\in\mathcal F$, $T$ is an $S^{\prime}$-scheme, and $\alpha:p(x)\xrightarrow{\sim}(T\to S^{\prime}\to S)$ is an isomorphism of $S$-schemes. An arrow is a pair $(b:x\to y,c:T\to V)$ with $\beta p(b)=c\alpha$ as $S$-maps. The projection sends the triple to $T$. If $U$ is an $S$-scheme and $a:h_U\to\mathcal F$ is a functor over $\mathit{Sch}/S$, form $U^{\prime}=U\times_S S^{\prime}$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. The induced map $h_{U^{\prime}}\to\mathcal F_{S^{\prime}}$ sends $V\to U^{\prime}$ to the image under $a$ of its composite $V\to U$, together with $V/S^{\prime}$ and the identity comparison of their $S$-bases; its arrows are the induced pairs. The auxiliary functor $h_{U^{\prime}}\to h_U$ on total categories is this composition with $U^{\prime}\to U$, viewing $V$ over $S$. These are constructions of categories and functors, with no assertion of algebraicity or stack descent.
